provenance: Synthetic MySQL activity demonstration fixtures, not measurements from a real MySQL server.
training_baseline: Both datasets have identical normal chronological training rows; incidents occur only after the recommended split.

metric_definitions.queries_per_second: queries/second averaged over the sampling interval
metric_definitions.connections: active client connections sampled as a gauge
metric_definitions.response_time_ms: milliseconds for a lightweight probe; synthetic baseline in these fixtures
metric_definitions.slow_queries: count of slow queries during the sampling interval (delta Slow_queries), not a lifetime counter
metric_definitions.connection_errors: count of failed connection attempts during the sampling interval (delta Aborted_connects), not all MySQL error categories or a lifetime counter

scenario_policy: scenario is test context only; neither labels nor scenario are model features
limitations: Designed functional tests with separated incident magnitudes; performance must be recomputed and cannot establish effectiveness on real workloads.
